title: Health Shocks and Annuity Choices
authors: Johannes Hagen; Michal Hodor; Abigail Hurwitz
main_or_robustness: main (cross-sectional logit of annuitization on pre-retirement cancer diagnosis) plus lab experiment

ineligible_specs.exclusion_reason: cross-sectional logit of the annuity choice at retirement on a pre-retirement cancer diagnosis indicator (i.pre) with controls and year FE; nonlinear, no unit FE, no panel
randomized lab experiment on default effects; not DiD

eligible_reason: Not a DiD design. Each retiree makes one annuity choice; the paper compares choices of individuals diagnosed with cancer shortly before retirement with others, using logit marginal effects with controls and year FE. A lab experiment complements the register analysis.
design_notes: Swedish register + Alecta pension data; 2a_do_analysis.do and 2b_do_analysis_add.do run logit depvar i.pre $controls. Money's worth ratio computations in 3a/3b.
data_files_note: Register and Alecta data are confidential (IFAU application required); only the lab experiment data and a public life table are shipped.
data_provenance_note: Main register data not shipped; lab experiment data are original.
screener_notes: Published text confirms cross-sectional logit design. Not a near miss.
